_comment: The factory's label vocabulary. Edit here, then run `uv run adws/actions/sync_labels.py --apply`. Meanings: docs/agents/triage-labels.md.

labels.name: needs-triage
labels.description: Maintainer needs to evaluate this issue

labels.name: needs-info
labels.description: Waiting on reporter for more information

labels.name: ready-for-agent
labels.description: Fully specified, ready for an AFK agent

labels.name: wontfix
labels.description: This will not be worked on

labels.name: in-progress
labels.description: Claimed: a run or session is working on it

labels.name: chore
labels.description: Plan type for a Ticket run: maintenance work

labels.name: feature
labels.description: Plan type for a Ticket run: new behaviour

labels.name: rework
labels.description: Factory review found a blocker: fix what the review named

labels.name: rework:1
labels.description: Factory review blocked this PR once

labels.name: rework:2
labels.description: Factory review blocked this PR twice

labels.name: rework:3
labels.description: Factory review blocked this PR three times; the next blocker goes to a human

labels.name: wayfinder:map
labels.description: Wayfinding map: notes, decisions so far and fog
